description: READ-ID with the staleness repaired (the earlier probe read 20 ms after the writer). Process b holds a dynaset over rows 4, 5, 6 positioned on row 5 and reads its Bookmark and values; a deletes row 5 and reinserts the same key and values (implicit statements), then again with changed N and V; b pauses 7 s, Idle, then Move 0 and reads the row and Bookmark, MoveNext/MovePrevious over the three rows, Requery and reads all rows with bookmarks. A fresh snapshot reads row 5. Asks whether a held cursor and its bookmark see a deleted-and-reinserted row as the same, a placeholder, or a new row.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
